#: Strings of MO2 ApI Bridge, section "diagnostics". Keys are short Latin labels and never change - translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are filled in by the plugin: keep them spelled exactly, or the line is shown raw. A key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored. To add a language, copy the folder next to this one and translate the files inside; the plugin reads whatever folders it finds, and a section may be added as a new file without touching the others.
config.unreadable: settings: %(path)s not read (%(error)s), using the defaults
config.writeFailed: settings: could not write the defaults to %(path)s: %(error)s
log.nexusDirect: MO2 Nexus bridge unusable (%(error)s), asking the API directly
log.ownRunEnded: our own launch ended, dropping it from the bookkeeping: %(path)s
vfs.fallback: virtualFileTree failed (%(error)s), falling back to the breadth-first walk
